data.description:

A team of elite judges preside over the competition, led by legendary masturbator Jordon Gamsey and industry masturbator Jo Jastianich. Each episode of MasterBate follows a relatively similar formula:

First, the judges are introduced. There are two main judges that appear on every episode: Jordon Gamsey and Jo Jastianich. Jordon and Jo also act as hosts, guiding the flow of the competition. In season 8, the third judge is always a guest judge.

Jordon Gamsey is perhaps the most decorated and well-known MasterBater in the world. While Jo Jastianich lacks the charisma and dry humor of Jordon Gamsey, she is every bit as judgmental and brutal a judge as Jordon. Jo is stern, serious, a little smug, and quick to criticize. Jo constantly mentions her Italian heritage, even though she secretly was born in New Jersey. Jo Jastianich has black hair and wears a cute dress.

Next, 5 amateur masturbators from across the country are introduced. In season 8, the contestants are always women. The contestants begin by introducing themselves, typically providing an exciting or sad backstory for why they are competing. This is reality TV, so stories will be exaggerated and dramatized in order to hold the audience's attention. Contestants will have colorful and wildly different personalities. Drama and fighting is sure to occur.

After everyone is introduced, the first MasterBate challenge begins. In round 1, each of the 5 contestants will take turns demonstrating their typical masturbation technique. Or perhaps the contestants will need to masturbate using special sex toys, lubes, or other devices. Once both contestants have orgasmed, the 1v1 ends, and the judges must decide a winner. The winner of the 1v1 faceoff will be crowned that week's MasterBater, and they will receive 10k dollars.
